name: github-source
description: Pull tasks from GitHub Issues, write results back
author: Denislav Prinov

configSchema.label: GitHub token
configSchema.help: Optional. Fine-grained PAT (Issues R/W + Metadata R) or {"$env":"GH_TOKEN"}. Leave blank to use the account the `gh` CLI is logged in as — note that token's scopes are usually far broader than this plugin needs

configSchema.label: Close issue on completion
configSchema.help: yes = close the issue (state_reason: completed) when a pipeline finishes successfully
